justification: Two of our fellas are sitting a bye this week with nothing but a zero next to their names, and I'm not going to leave a hole in the lineup like a man who doesn't check his own depth chart - Dowdle's out, Hampton steps in and earns it; Wan'Dale's out, Keenan Allen steps in, same as he's been doing every Sunday since we brought him on. Mark Andrews gave us a quiet week against a tough look, but that's one bad game, not a pattern, and in my program a guy who competes gets one more week to respond before I ever bury him - he starts. Amon-Ra's questionable, but he's practiced all week and told his people he's good to go, and I trust a man's own word over a tag on a sheet every time. Cousins, Corum, McPherson, and the Chargers defense did their jobs last week and they'll do them again - no reason to go chasing something shinier off a spreadsheet. Clear eyes, full hearts.
forum_post: We don't run this program off what gets printed or what gets said about character - we just show up, do the work, and let Sunday handle the rest. Good luck to Ed and the Tropics; may the best effort win.
